newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cigarette maker ups H1 96/7 profit.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cigarette maker ups H1 96/7 profit.

text.p: Egypt's cigarette maker Eastern Company raised net profits for the first half of financial 1996/7 to 67.9 million pounds ($19.9 million) from 43.2 million in the same year ago period, a company official said on Sunday.
The financial year ends on June 30.

The firm, which has a monopoly on making cigarettes in Egypt, said after-tax profits for the previous financial year were 145.8 million pounds, 2.9 percent higher from 141.7 million in 1994/5. It gave shareholders a 4.0 pound dividend for 1995/6.

Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid was quoted in government-owned newspapers earlier this month as saying the state would privatise shares in Eastern so that private investors would own more than 51 percent of the firm. He did not say when that would happen.
